tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Karnataka labour Department Registration Certificate and Society Registration Certificate : (Attach valid certificate) Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)
Provident fund(PF) Registration Certificate: (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)
ESI Department Registration Certificate: (Attach valid Registration Certificate of agency obtained from the issuing authorities)

The bidder should not have any ongoing any litigation/Arbitration History with any Government department/Public sector undertaking/ Private sector or any other agency for which we have executed/undertaken the works/services during last 5 years

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bidder should have minimum 10 years of experience in the field of providing manpower services
Annual financial turnover of at least Rs.20.00 Crores in any one year of the last five years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed, at least one similar Contract of Providing technical and non- technical Manpower Services of value not less than Rs. 2.00 Crores in any one year of the last five financial years.

Satisfactorily completed services for providing technical/non-technical manpower of total 20 Nos of value not less than Rs. 40,000/-each (Per month) or not less than Rs.4,80,000/-each (Per year) in any one year in last five financial years
ESI Payments Clearance Certificates from the concerned Department of any two years out of last five financial years
EPF Payments Clearance Certificates from the concerned Department of any two years out of last five financial years
GST-3B returns of last month or quarter
